author: openfishtools
name: FishTracker Golang - 1000 Titik Max
description: Camera tracker 1000 titik gila, export .ofts (FishTools Studio) + .kf (Keyflow). 3GB RAM optimized, GoCV + RANSAC 1.5px + Kalman. Hasil sekelas Python.
startup: export GOPATH=/home/container/go && export GOCACHE=/home/container/.cache/go-build && export GOMODCACHE=/home/container/go/pkg/mod && export GO111MODULE=on && mkdir -p $GOPATH $GOCACHE $GOMODCACHE && if [ ! -f ./fishtracker ]; then go mod tidy && go build -o fishtracker -ldflags="-s -w" main.go && chmod +x fishtracker; fi && ./fishtracker

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt-get update
apt-get install -y libopencv-dev libopencv-contrib-dev pkg-config git
mkdir -p /mnt/server/templates
cd /mnt/server
echo "Installed OpenCV for GoCV"
